reviews.x: I have used eyebrow pencil since my early 20's.  As I have aged, I was happy that I found this AFY Long lasting and Waterproof Professional Makeup Auto Eyebrow Pencil (No.2 Natural Gray) on Amazon.  The grey color matches my hair coloring very well, is easy to apply, and is long-lasting. This needs ONLY a gentle & light touch when applying & be sure you use the brush after application as it gives a finishing touch to the eyebrow appearance. I will DEFINITELY purchase this product again.

This came with three different shaped tips to switch out plus the brush end- the brand is ROZO, and the color is “gray4#” not gray#2 so I think the brand was switched out. It’s not waterproof since I had tested it in the back of my clean, dry hand and it all brushed off very easily- I barely rubbed where I marked my hand but all the evidence of color was gone.

Very pretty shade of gray.  Perhaps it is my skin type, but it smudged and for that reason I couldn't use it.  On the upside, if you are looking for an actual gray brow pencil this is it.  I bought two boxes, it would have been enough to last for at least a year.  You got the original plus additional refills in each box.  I was disappointed that it didn't work our for me, but like I said, it may have been my skin type.  Great price.

I really like this eyebrow pencil. It goes on easily and looks much more natural with my gray/white hair than any eyebrow pencil I've purchased before. I hadn't been able to find one in gray until now. It's slanted so it's easier to follow the  natural shape of the eyebrow, plus there's an eyebrow brush in the end of the pencil which helps to keep the eyebrows looking natural. Goes on easily and stays put. I recently went camping in North Carolina, and despite temps in the high 90's, my eyebrows

reviews.t: It’s very difficult to find grey brow pencil in the store. This product is a keeper!
reviews.x: Finally a grey eye brow pencil that is easy to apply and matches my silver grey hair. Will buy again for sure!

reviews.t: Blends with hair better than a anything!
reviews.x: I am 71 yo and my hair is brown with a good start toward gray (looks heavily frosted). Have not been able to find an eyebrow color that really matched till now. This color blends well and looks more natural than anything I have tried.  I am extremely pleased with it.
Love this eyebrow pencil, been looking for a good gray that was not too dark for my grey/silver hair.

I have had platinum blonde hair (hair with no pigment) since I was young and now that I am in my 60's it is so hard to find the right eyebrow color for my coloring--not gray hair but platinum. This color is perfect. I have every brow product known to man and have finally found just the right color. If you use a light touch you can achieve a light gray. Love it.

I just received it and applied it went out for hours in a high humid conditions and came back looking exactly the same awesome product and I love the fact that it comes with two extra refills it is a perfect shade of gray for me will be buying again

reviews.t: An Eyebrow Pencil That Lasts And Is My Color Match
reviews.x: I am actually delighted with this eyebrow pencil. It is the color I've been searching for (with a blond gel I use over it), goes on easily and evenly (great applicator), and lasts...even overnight. This is beauty happiness. Thank you, AFY.
Nice, a little softer than i expected. So the color is good its almost impossible to find a decent shade of grey, this is great because it work well with my use to be brown brows.  Thanks Me-G
I liked the refill cartridges, that was nice...but I was hoping for a light grey color...this just looks like dark charcoal. My search for grey eyebrow pencil continues.
The grey is perfect for me and I love the angled pencil.  The color lasts all day and into the evening.  You'll be very pleased!!
It's super easy to apply because of the angle.  It's natural looking.  It was worth the expense  And it stays on.
Finally...a gray that is gray!!! Thank you!!

I have black hair that is full of gray.  I've tried many eyebrow pencils over the years.  I want my eyebrows to look natural and not too dark.  This product has ended my search for the perfect eyebrow pencil.  It has a quality retractable tip and a great brush.  Compared to the top name brands this eyebrow pencil wins hands down.  It is easy to apply and lasts all day without smearing.  I have already ordered more so I don't have to worry about finding it in the future.

reviews.t: Very good product but different from what a received 6 weeks ago.
reviews.x: I ordered this product at the end of May and it came with 2 refills. I really like the way the color goes on and the color gray is perfect to compliment my hair color. I decided to order another pencil for my travel bag and this time it came in a different package without refills. The price is good even without the refills but be aware that if you order it, there will not be any refills.

I love this eyebrow pencil.  The dark grey color is perfect with my hair.  It goes on easier than any other very expensive brow pencils that I have tried in the past.  It stays on until I wash my face.  I highly recommend this product.

If you happen to have been a henna head, and you are growing out the salt and pepper gray, this is the perfect shade. Love the packaging and the angle of the pencil and the brush that gives custom subtlety.

reviews.t: Finally a brow pencil for grey hair!
reviews.x: This is great to have grey.what a surprise! I never saw grey before. Matches my hair perfect and looks great on me.For anyone who colors their hair these beautiful grey shades try the pencil.
I bought this because it was a light gray it's very difficult to find light gray pencil works out wonderful love the brush on the end just moved everything out so I will buy again
Great true grey color that actually goes with  Ash blonde hair. It comes with 3 different attachments. I like one more than the others but I love the color so I don't care
It seems impossible to find gray eyebrow pencil that isn't really black.  This product is exactly what I've been looking for and reasonably priced.
I ordered grey and I was so impressed I guess I didn’t read it came with two refills so that was super cool great overall product, I’ll order again
Best eyebrow pencil I have ever used. I have purchase so many in the past and now I found one that really works and stays on.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the gray shade for matching their gray, silver, or platinum hair and looking natural.
Many reviewers find the pencil easy to apply, often highlighting the angled tip and applicator.
Several reviewers say the color lasts a long time, including all day, into the evening, overnight, and in humid conditions.
A few reviewers report the product smudged or rubbed off easily and was not waterproof as expected.
Some reviewers note the color was not the light gray they expected, describing it as dark charcoal or a different shade than anticipated.
